title: Summer Mathematics Program for High School Students
sponsor: University of Utah Department of Mathematics
who_text: High school students ready to start calculus, with preference for students between junior and senior year; costs are covered for U.S. citizens, nationals, and permanent residents
description: This is a free summer math program on the University of Utah campus in Salt Lake City. You spend weekdays for a few weeks working on advanced math with university faculty. It is a day program, so you need to live nearby or arrange your own housing.
